statement: ∃ b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V, ∀ i, b i = e y v i.val
proof:
classical
let μ : Index lam → ℂ := fun i => ((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ)
have hinj : Function.Injective μ := by
  intro i j hij
  have hij' : lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) = lam - 2 * (j.val : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hij
  apply Fin.ext
  omega
have hli : LinearIndependent ℂ (fun i : Index lam => e y v i.val) :=
  h.eigenvectors_linearIndependent' μ hinj _ (fun i =>
    ⟨Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (h_T002 i).2, (h_T002 i).1⟩)
have hcard : Fintype.card (Index lam) = Module.finrank ℂ V := by
  rw [h_H003.2.1]
  simp only [Index, Fintype.card_fin]
  omega
let b := basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank hli hcard
refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
intro i
exact congrFun (coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank hli hcard) i
